facts.text: John and his partner had their first dance at a cozy restaurant with candlelight and music.

evidence.quote: That dance was great! We had our first dance at a cozy restaurant. It was so dreamy with the music and candlelight.
Wow, a candlelit dance in a cozy restaurant! Sounds like a fairytale!

facts.text: John and his partner were surrounded by friends and family during their first dance at the restaurant.

evidence.quote: We were so lucky to have everyone with us!
It's moments like these that bring love and joy.

facts.text: John described seeing his partner walk down the aisle as a magical moment that made him emotional.

evidence.quote: Seeing her walking down the aisle, her face lit up and it got me all choked up. What a magical moment - one I'll always remember.
I'm lucky to have you in my life, bringing so much love and joy.
